title: Implement Real-time Data Updates
description: Set up real-time updates for the financial dashboard to reflect changes within 5 seconds of transaction entry.
acceptance_criteria: Real-time updates are implemented using WebSockets or similar technology.
Dashboard reflects data changes within 5 seconds.
Testing confirms the accuracy of real-time updates.
